name: Breaker-failure current-check gate
summary: Uses the assigned current measurement to assess continued conduction after a breaker-failure initiation.
description: Uses the assigned current measurement to assess continued conduction after a breaker-failure initiation. A protection scheme combines measurements, decision elements and communication or trip outputs to protect a defined part of the network. A function number names a job; the scheme interface shows how that job connects to other equipment.

In a substation feeder bay, local current and voltage measurements may combine with a remote-end signal before the protection issues the assigned trip request. Backup actions use their own defined initiations and supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Post-trip current condition” at the input and “Breaker-failure current check” at the output. The selected current criterion is application-specific.
